name: wordnet
about: Word pairs a reader trades when quoting from memory, each with the share of a typed word's weight align.js gives the text that says its partner in its place (search200 B7). Keys are light lemmas (search/passage.js), so a pair covers its forms; format: search/lexicon.js. 0.7 one WordNet synset and 0.6 a similar-to link, both among the two words' two most frequent senses; 0.5 either through a less frequent sense, or a direct hypernym link among the most frequent senses. Both words are held by the corpus the app searches. Generated: do not edit.
